items.title: 'A win at home in the first game was beyond anyone's dreams' - Holden on MOTD
items.description: Following their huge win against Manchester United, Hull City assistant head coach Dean Holden joins Gabby Logan, Danny Murphy and Joe Hart in the Match of the Day studio.

items.title: Infantino must remember he is European - Ceferin
items.description: Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin says his Fifa counterpart Gianni Infantino's attempt to sell off a stake in the World Cup was "worse than the Super League".

items.title: How Hull kept plan to stun Man Utd secret
items.description: Hull City boss Sergej Jakirovic kept his plan to topple Manchester United on their Premier League return under wraps for weeks, assistant head coach Dean Holden tells Match of the Day.

items.title: Why 'woeful' Villa crumbled against Brighton
items.description: Match of the Day's Danny Murphy, Gabby Logan and Joe Hart analyse Aston Villa's "woeful" performance against Brighton, which saw them lose 4-0.

items.title: How the Guehi gamble paid off for Maresca
items.description: Match of the Day's Joe Hart discusses Manchester City's Marc Guehi and his performance in midfield, with plenty of praise for the centre half in a different position against Bournemouth.

items.title: 'Energy, pace, passion' - Newcastle's dynamic performance against Liverpool
items.description: Match of the Day's Joe Hart, Danny Murphy and Gabby Logan analyse Newcastle's energetic performance in their Premier League opener against Liverpool.

items.title: Gordon gets two assists in Barca rout | Amorim's AC Milan win | PSG draw
'It would appear he's no longer wanting to play for Aston Villa' - does Watkins want out?
items.description: After being left out of Aston Villa's match-day squad against Brighton, Match of the Day's Gabby Logan, Danny Murphy and Joe Hart consider if Ollie Watkins is on the verge of leaving the club for Al Hilal.

items.title: Papers: Palace prepare audacious £50m bid for West Ham captain Bowen
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Monday's newspapers...

items.title: Hits and misses: Maresca's Man City experiment gets lucky
Nev: Wirtz and Isak Liverpool's biggest disappointments - they must improve
items.description: Gary Neville called on Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak to improve after a year of "being kind to" Liverpool's £200m+ duo, but said he had faith the pair would come good despite being their "biggest disappointments" at Newcastle.

items.title: Signs that Jaissle's Newcastle are not to be written off
items.description: Newcastle United were predicted to struggle from the off by some pundits, but head coach Matthias Jaissle will take encouragement from aspects of their display even after conceding a late equaliser against Liverpool
